name: Compute Cluster S75: Trend & Directional Indicators
description: Tests: adxr, aroon, aroonosc, di, dm, dx, supertrend, mass, cvi, tr, md, elders_thermometer, price_distance. Directional movement and trend strength indicators.
source:
# =============================================================================
# COMPUTE CLUSTER S75: Trend & Directional Indicators
# =============================================================================

src = study_assets()
high = src.h
low = src.l
close = src.c

# === DIRECTIONAL MOVEMENT FAMILY ===
di_val = di(high, low, close, period=14)
di_plus = di_val.plus_di
di_minus = di_val.minus_di

dm_val = dm(high, low, period=14)
dm_plus = dm_val.plus_dm
dm_minus = dm_val.minus_dm

dx_val = dx(high, low, 14)
adxr_val = adxr(high, low, 14)

# === AROON ===
aroon_val = aroon(high, low, period=25)
aroon_up = aroon_val.aroon_up
aroon_down = aroon_val.aroon_down
aroonosc_val = aroonosc(high, low, 25)

# === SUPERTREND ===
st = supertrend(high, low, close, atr_period=10, multiplier=3.0)
st_line = st.supertrend
st_dir = st.direction

# === TRUE RANGE ===
tr_val = tr()(high, low, close)

# === MASS INDEX ===
mass_val = mass(high, low, 25)

# === CHAIKIN VOLATILITY INDEX ===
cvi_val = cvi(high, low, 14)

# === MCGINLEY DYNAMIC ===
md_val = md(close, 14)

# === ELDER'S THERMOMETER ===
et = elders_thermometer(period=14)(high, low)

# === PRICE DISTANCE ===
pd_val = price_distance()(high, low, close)

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title='DI+ / DI- (14d)',
    category='Directional',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='DI+', color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='DI-', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(di_plus, di_minus))

xy_lines(
    title='DX / ADXR (14d)',
    category='Directional',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='DX', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='ADXR', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(dx_val, adxr_val))

xy_lines(
    title='Aroon Up/Down & Osc (25d)',
    category='Trend',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Aroon Up', color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Aroon Down', color=Color.Red),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Aroon Osc', color=Color.Blue)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(aroon_up, aroon_down, aroonosc_val))

xy_lines(
    title='Supertrend (10,3)',
    category='Trend',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Close', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Supertrend', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(close, st_line))

xy_lines(
    title='TR / Mass Index / CVI',
    category='Volatility',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='TR', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Mass(25)', color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='CVI(14)', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(tr_val, mass_val, cvi_val))

xy_lines(
    title='McGinley Dynamic / Price Distance',
    category='Trend',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Close', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='MD(14)', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(close, md_val))
